title: Sales Manager - Retail
jobDescription:
Sales Manager
- Retail About Mintifi We are a fast-growing, profitable, Series-D fintech company building India's first data-driven supply chain financing platform. We are funded by marquee investors including Premji Invest, Norwest Venture Partners, Elevation Capital, IFC (World Bank) and Lok Capital. We are solving a huge problem of inefficient and costly access to credit for millions of Indian distributors and retailers using data-driven credit models. We are disrupting the supply chain lending landscape in India in partnership with blue-chip companies by digitizing the end-to-end processes, enabling quicker decision making and higher operational efficiencies by using technology, and making effective front-end interfaces on both mobile and web to make lending a smooth experience. We are a systematically important RBI-regulated NBFC with a strong balance sheet. Position Summary: We are looking for a highly motivated and results-oriented Sales Manager to join our team in promoting and selling our Supply Chain Finance product in our company. As a Sales Manager, you will play a critical role in driving business growth by identifying potential clients, building relationships, and closing sales deals for our supply chain finance solutions.

RESPONSIBILITIES:
1) Sales Execution:
- Conduct effective sales presentations and product demonstrations to prospective clients.
- Understand client requirements and tailor the Supply Chain Finance product offering to meet their specific needs.
- Present pricing, terms, and conditions to clients and negotiate agreements to close sales deals.
- Collaborate with internal teams to ensure smooth onboarding and implementation for new clients. 2) Relationship Management:
- Develop and nurture long-term relationships with clients to maximize customer satisfaction and retention.
- Provide ongoing support and assistance to clients, addressing their queries and concerns promptly.
- Conduct regular follow-ups with clients to identify additional opportunities and upsell/cross-sell our products. 3) Sales Reporting and Analysis:
- Maintain accurate and up-to-date records of all sales activities and client interactions in the CRM system.
- Prepare regular sales reports and forecasts for management review.
- Analyze sales performance metrics to identify trends, opportunities, and areas for improvement. 4) Market Intelligence:
- Stay updated on industry trends, market developments, and competitor activities.
- Continuously enhance product knowledge and remain well-informed about supply chain finance concepts and practices. Qualifications and Requirements:
- Bachelor's degree in business, finance, or a related field.
- Proven track record of at least 2-3 years in sales, preferably in the distribution sector (FMCG/FMCD/Paints/Wires/Batteries/Tyres, etc).
- Understanding of supply chain finance or working capital solutions is desirable.
- Excellent communication and presentation skills with the ability to effectively communicate complex ideas.
- Strong negotiation and relationship-building skills.
- Self-motivated, target-driven, and able to work independently.
- Comfort in using CRM software and other sales tools.
- Willingness to travel extensively to meet clients and attend industry events.

title: Relationship Manager - SME
jobDescription:
Job Title: Relationship Manager (RM) – SME Role Overview The Relationship Manager will be responsible for sourcing, acquiring, and managing SME clients for unsecured business loans, working capital facilities, and term loans. The role involves end-to-end ownership of sales, preliminary credit assessment, loan processing, and portfolio quality management. Key Responsibilities
1. Sourcing & Acquisition Generate and acquire new SME customers for unsecured business loans, working capital loans, and term loans. Build a strong local market presence through direct sourcing and referrals.
2. Channel Management Develop and manage a network of DSAs, connectors, and channel partners. Drive consistent lead generation through partner engagement.
3. Sales & Target Achievement Achieve monthly and quarterly disbursement targets (individual or team-based), typically ranging from ₹10–20 Cr per month. Monitor pipeline and conversion ratios to ensure target closure.
4. Credit Assessment Conduct preliminary credit evaluation by analyzing: Bank statements ITRs and financials CIBIL and bureau reports Ensure accurate profiling before submitting cases to credit teams.
5. Loan Processing & Coordination Coordinate with internal credit, legal, and operations teams for smooth documentation, approvals, and disbursements. Ensure TAT adherence and customer satisfaction.
6. Portfolio Quality Management Ensure high-quality sourcing to minimize early delinquencies and NPAs. Monitor post-disbursement performance and client behavior.
7. Customer Relationship Management Build long-term relationships with SME customers. Drive repeat business, renewals, and cross-sell opportunities. Required Candidate Profile Experience 2–7 years of experience in SME/MSME unsecured business loan sales. Background from NBFCs, Fintechs, or Banks preferred. Experience with companies like Bajaj Finserv, Lendingkart, Capital Float, HDB Financial Services, etc., is an advantage. Knowledge Strong understanding of SME lending products, working capital cycles, and cash-flow based lending. Good grasp of financial analysis and credit fundamentals. Skills Strong negotiation, networking, and relationship management skills. Working knowledge of CRM tools and MS Excel. Education Graduate (B.Com preferred). MBA (Finance) is an added advantage. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) Total Disbursement Volume (Monthly / Annual) Portfolio Delinquency Rate (30+ DPD) Lead-to-Disbursement Conversion Ratio Number of Active DSA / Channel Partners Compensation & Benefits Incentives: Highly performance-driven, linked to disbursement volumes Fast growth and exposure in the SME lending ecosystem

title: Business Development (SCF)
jobDescription:
Business Development (Supply Chain Finance) About the Role We are looking for a dynamic and result-oriented Manager – Business Development to drive regional growth for our Supply Chain Financing (SCF) business. The role will focus on both new business acquisition (hunting) and account expansion (farming) , with end-to-end ownership of revenue growth, client engagement, portfolio utilization, and customer satisfaction within the assigned region. The incumbent will work closely with internal teams including Sales, Credit, Operations, Product, and Technology to structure, launch, and scale SCF programs that create value for corporates, distributors, and retailers. Key Responsibilities
1. Business Development & Client Acquisition Identify, approach, and onboard new corporate anchors, regional brands, and companies for Supply Chain Finance programs. Build and manage a strong business pipeline through market intelligence, networking, referrals, industry forums, and channel partnerships. Understand client working capital requirements and design customized SCF solutions. Lead client presentations, commercial discussions, and negotiations with senior stakeholders including CFOs and Treasury teams. Drive revenue growth and achieve regional business targets.
2. Account Management & Portfolio Growth Manage and grow a portfolio of anchor-led SCF programs across the region. Ensure program utilization by increasing adoption among distributors, dealers, retailers, and other downstream partners. Develop strategic account plans focused on portfolio expansion, penetration, ticket size growth, and cross-selling opportunities. Build long-term client relationships to ensure retention, satisfaction, and repeat business.
3. Cross-Functional Coordination Sales Team Collaborate on market segmentation, anchor acquisition strategies, and regional go-to-market plans. Credit & Risk Team Support underwriting processes by sharing market intelligence and portfolio insights. Coordinate with anchors for resolution of high-risk and overdue cases. Operations Team Ensure seamless onboarding, documentation, disbursement, and repayment processes. Resolve operational escalations promptly to maintain strong client trust and service standards. Product & Technology Team Provide customer feedback and market insights to improve SCF products and processes. Support innovation initiatives and digitization efforts for enhanced customer experience.
4. Strategy, Reporting & Market Intelligence Monitor and track business pipeline, closures, disbursement volumes, utilization rates, overdue trends, and overall portfolio performance. Analyze competitor activities, industry trends, and client behavior to refine regional strategies. Prepare MIS reports, business reviews, and performance presentations for senior leadership. Candidate Requirements Bachelor’s degree in business, Commerce, Finance, or related discipline. MBA preferred. 7–12 years of experience in Business Development, Key Account Management, Corporate Sales, or Relationship Management within financial services, fintech, trade finance, or Supply Chain Finance. Strong understanding of credit evaluation, KYC processes, distributor ecosystems, and anchor-led supply chains. Proven track record of acquiring and scaling business accounts with measurable revenue impact. Excellent communication, negotiation, stakeholder management, and relationship-building skills. Ability to work collaboratively across multiple functions and manage regional business responsibilities independently. Strong regional market knowledge and willingness to travel extensively within the assigned territory. What We Offer Opportunity to lead and own a high-growth business region with AUM responsibility. Exposure to senior corporate stakeholders including CXOs, CFOs, and Supply Chain Leaders. A collaborative and fast-paced fintech environment with opportunities to influence product strategy and business growth. Competitive compensation structure with performance-linked incentives and accelerated career progression into leadership roles.

title: Internal Audit Intern
jobDescription: About Mintifi Mintifi is a financial technology company that offers Advanced Receivables Management solutions to help SMEs optimize their potential for growth. Catering to 250+ cities in India, Mintifi provides channel finance services to scale businesses and solve working capital issues in the supply chain. Founded in 2017, Mintifi has brought automation to the lending space and is backed by investors including the World Bank's International Finance Corporation. Role Description This is an on-site internship role for an Internal Audit Intern located in Mumbai. The Intern will be responsible for assisting in audit reports, utilizing analytical skills, understanding finance processes, effective communication, and participating in financial audits on a day-to-day basis. Qualifications Audit Reports and Financial Audits skills Analytical Skills and Finance knowledge Effective Communication skills Ability to work in a fast-paced environment Strong attention to detail Graduate or pursuing a degree in Finance, Accounting, or related field
